top_band: light sandy tan flat roof terrace with parapet wall, rug and hatch, rows 0-31
evidence: Rows 0-31 show the flat roof surface from above (lighter sandy tan with inner parapet shadow at rows 3-5, a rug, a roof hatch, and a light front parapet highlight at rows 28-31). Rows 32-33 form a dark eave shadow beneath the cornice, and rows 34-63 show the vertical mudbrick front wall with inset beam ends, arched door, and latticed window.

style.evidence: While the palette and dark-brown material outlines are appropriate, the surface texture relies on sparse, mechanical single-pixel noise over large flat fills (especially the roof terrace, the 12x9 flat red rug center, and the flat white door arch) rather than the dense, sculpted stone/plaster/timber detail of the Beodeul reference houses.
